title: Window Washing Checklist
subtitle: Residential Window Washing: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Window Washing Checklist covers window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish. The window service coordinator records Residential Window Washing criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Window Washing Checklist keeps Residential Window Washing exceptions visible until the window service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Window Washing Checklist at residence interior, exterior elevation, ladder area, roof access, and protected room. Document window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish identity before Residential Window Washing begins. Compare window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish findings with stated Residential Window Washing criteria; route unresolved Residential Window Washing issues to exterior cleaning supervisor. For Window Washing Checklist, confirm requirements for Residential Window Washing. Ask exterior cleaning supervisor to review Residential Window Washing conditions beyond the window service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Checklist context and subject record
sections.guidance: For Residential Window Washing, identify responsible parties, residence interior, exterior elevation, ladder area, roof access, and protected room, and the linked window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish source.

fields.label: Window count, elevation, and unit identifier
Selected interior, exterior, screen, track, and hard-water scope

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Window Washing facts for window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Residential Window Washing inspection checks
items: Glass soil, coating, scratch, chip, and seal indication
Frame, sash, lock, screen, track, and sill condition
Paint, film, tint, treatment, and product restriction
Ladder, roof, ground, weather, and overhead-line access
Interior furnishing, floor, wall, and privacy protection
Completed pane count and quality check

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: Before closing Residential Window Washing, identify what failed or was not inspected, who owns correction, and when examination resumes. Window Service Coordinator preserves the decision.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Unsafe height, weather, ground, roof, or electrical proximity
Damaged glass, frame, lock, or screen
Private or restricted area not cleared
Pre-existing glass and frame condition images
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Window Washing when safe access, damaged glazing, product compatibility, privacy, or opening security remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Window Washing proof and route unresolved window unit, glass, frame, screen, sill, access method, and adjacent finish scope to window service coordinator.
